985-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2232-2781-7678-8327.easyPrerequisites: You are able to activate one of Feroz's loyalty abilities this turn.
2232-2781-7678-8327.notablePrerequisites: Urza Assembles the Titans' third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2232-2781-7678-8327.description:
Activate Feroz's second loyalty ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to draw a card and put Felidar Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Feroz.
When Feroz enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Feroz's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Bird creature tokens with flying.
When the Birds enter, Cloudstone Curio triggers. Choose to return Felidar Guardian from the battlefield to your hand with one trigger, and nothing to your hand with the other trigger.
Repeat.

4488-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2313-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

275-893-1558-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
275-893-1558-4840.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

240-2921-4875.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2921-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1636-5231-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1796-1824-2530-2932.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-2932.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

4050-5170-6132-6559.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-2558-3967-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-3967-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

1987-4276-5913-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-5913-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Pinnacle Monk
When Donnie & April and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-5913-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2933-4013-5798-6968.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1636-6773-6798.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-6773-6798.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

1117-3689-6518-6709.notablePrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1117-3689-6518-6709.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2757-3525-6702.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping an Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-4785-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-4785-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2792-5140-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2792-5140-5147.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Great Whale, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1267-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
"Assassin" chosen with  Conspiracy.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Medomai the Ageless token.
During the combat phase of your extra turn, declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

860-1887-3663.notablePrerequisites: Calix does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
860-1887-3663.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Calix.
Calix's second ability triggers, creating a token copy of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice token enters the battlefield with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex, triggering its first and second chapter abilities, as well as Calix's first ability.
Resolve the Calix trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a 1/1 Mouse creature token.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 3.

803-3252-3809-4508.description:
Activate Shivan Hellkite by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1719-3147-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3147-4222.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

643-1374-3693.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista dies as a state based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat.

654-1021-2167-3470.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.
